name: Radicchio
siboNotes: Well-tolerated on SIBO diets due to naturally low FODMAP content. The bitter compounds may actually support digestive health.
preparationTips: Grilling or roasting reduces bitterness and enhances flavor
Soak chopped radicchio in cold water for 30 minutes to mellow bitterness
Pair with sweet or fatty ingredients to balance the bitter taste
Use outer leaves for cooking and tender inner leaves for raw salads
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin K for bone health
Contains beneficial bitter compounds that may support liver function
